description: github: Repositories. GET /v1/github/user/repositories. Provide one of: handle, url. Get public repositories for a GitHub user. Supports pagination and GitHub's repo sorting options. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous response. Defaults to 1.

handle.description: GitHub username/handle of the user you want the repositories for

sort.description: Sort by created, updated, pushed, or full_name. Defaults to updated.

type.description: Repository type. Defaults to owner. GitHub also supports all and member.

name: github_user_repositories
